train_DPTModel: create a Trainer with config then call train passing train and validation dataloaders
run_eval_validation: run evaluation on a validation dataloader by calling run_eval on an existing Trainer instance
save_model_checkpoint: save the current model state dict and optimizer states to disk using save_model
log_images_wandb: log input images depth predictions and segmentation predictions to wandb using img_logger
init_Trainer_with_config: instantiate a Trainer passing a config dict to initialize the DPTModel optimizers and schedulers
